title: 第9章接管临江城关闭粮仓第 10章 宴请四大粮商
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 定国公府外。
一辆马车，以及十多个禁军正在等待。
高阳见状直接带着绿萝钻进了马车，但当看到上官婉儿那张面庞后，他满脸诧异。
“上官大人怎么在这？”
上官婉儿端坐着，俏脸冰冷，“陛下有旨，命我随你一同前去临江城。”
高阳略微思索，便明白了过来。
他大大方方的坐下，点头道，“也是，毕竟是一城之百姓，容不得闪失。”
上官婉儿有些诧异，美眸落在高阳身上。
她没想到，高阳竟然这么快就意识到了武曌派她跟着前去的目的。
“高公子的确聪明，难怪陛下如此看重。”
上官婉儿缓缓开口。
“难怪？看重？”
“看来陛下的考核，不止我一个人啊，如果没猜错的话，还有崔状元吧。”
此言一出，上官婉儿的脸色狂变。
她下意识的问道，“你怎么知道？”
当看到上官婉儿的反应，高阳明白了一切。
他继续道，“此行，我有多大的权利？”
上官婉儿沉声回道，“监察御史，代陛下巡视天下，掌生杀大权，临江城一切，上到县令，下到百姓，高公子皆可指挥！”
“也包括你？”
上官婉儿犹豫片刻，点了点头。
从诏令来看，除非高阳做的太过，否则她也要听高阳指挥。
“上官大人，看看腿。”
高阳笑着说道。
此言一出，上官婉儿脸色狂变，一股杀意席卷，几乎整个马车内的温度，都骤然下降了八度。
“高公子，你这话是不是太冒昧了一些？”
高阳摸了摸鼻子，实锤了。
这上官婉儿握着来自武曌的尚方宝剑，但只要他在临江城乃是老大。
这事倒也好办了。
一帮发国难财的粮商，大肆抬高粮价。
他的眸子中，露出一股冷意。
绿萝感受着马车内的气氛，小心翼翼的将两条笔直、纤细的美腿侧向高阳。
“大公子，要不先看看奴婢的腿？”
几人相对无言。
马车很快使出了长安城，高阳掀开马车，注视着远处巍峨伫立的长安城。
content_en:
Outside the Duke Ding's mansion.
A carriage and more than a dozen Imperial Guards were waiting.
Upon seeing this, Gao Yang got into the carriage with Lu Luo, but when he saw Shangguan Wan'er's face, he was full of surprise.
"Why are you here, Lord Shangguan?"
Shangguan Wan'er sat upright with a cold face, "Your Majesty has a decree and orders me to go to Linjiang City with you."
Gao Yang thought for a moment and then understood.
He sat down magnanimously, nodded and said, "That's right. After all, we are the people of a city and cannot tolerate any mistakes."
Shangguan Wan'er was a little surprised, and her beautiful eyes fell on Gao Yang.
She didn't expect that Gao Yang would realize Wu Zhao's purpose of sending her to follow him so quickly.
"Young Master Gao is indeed smart. No wonder His Majesty values him so highly."
Shangguan Wan'er spoke slowly.
"No wonder? Do you care?"
"It seems that I am not the only one in His Majesty's assessment. If I am not mistaken, there must also be Cui Zhuangyuan."
As soon as these words came out, Shangguan Wan'er's expression changed wildly.
She asked subconsciously, "How do you know?"
When he saw Shangguan Wan'er's reaction, Gao Yang understood everything.
He continued, "How much authority do I have on this trip?"
Shangguan Wan'er replied in a deep voice, "Supervising the censor, patrolling the world on behalf of His Majesty, holding the power of life and death, everything in Linjiang City, from the county magistrate to the common people, Mr. Gao can command them all!"
"Including you?"
Shangguan Wan'er hesitated for a moment and nodded.
Judging from the edict, unless Gao Yang goes too far, she must also obey Gao Yang's command.
"Sir Shangguan, look at your legs."
Gao Yang said with a smile.
As soon as these words came out, Shangguan Wan'er's face changed wildly, a murderous intent swept over her, and the temperature in almost the entire carriage suddenly dropped eight degrees.
"Mr. Gao, are your words too presumptuous?"
Gao Yang touched his nose and confirmed.
This Shangguan Wan'er holds the Shang Fang sword from Wu Zhao, but as long as he is the boss in Linjiang City.
This matter is actually easier to handle.
A group of grain dealers who are struggling to make money for the country wantonly raise the price of grain.
There was a coldness in his eyes.
Luluo felt the atmosphere in the carriage and carefully turned her two straight, slender legs towards Gao Yang.
"Master, why don't you take a look at your slave's legs first?"
Several people were relatively speechless.
The carriage quickly left Chang'an City. Gao Yang opened the carriage and stared at the majestic Chang'an City standing in the distance.
